adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff introduces `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and then uses it directly in `group.users...limit(limit)` with no server-side maximum. This allows a client to request an arbitrarily large `limit`, resulting in very heavy queries and effectively dumping all members of any group visible via `guardian.ensure_can_see!`.
